name: forge
description: Forge — team project management. Netlify build orchestration for the React frontend + serverless API.

scripts.//: build:netlify runs on Netlify's Linux build image (sh) — not meant for Windows. --include=dev is required because NODE_ENV=production would otherwise skip Vite and drizzle-kit.
scripts.build:netlify: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix api install --include=dev && npm --prefix api run db:migrate && ( [ "$SEED_ON_START" = "true" ] && npm --prefix api run db:seed || echo 'Skipping seed (set SEED_ON_START=true to seed demo data)' )
